newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to stop use of overdrafts in share issues.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to stop use of overdrafts in share issues.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange has decided to check bank accounts to ensure that real funds are in place to cover bids for new share listings, the China Securities newspaper said on Friday.
The move followed an urgent order from the China Securities Regulatory Commission last month banning the use of overdrafts in new share issues.
One day will be added to the processing period for all share issues to allow bidders' bank accounts to be checked, the newspaper said.
Chinese stock analysts said the speculative fever seen in the share markets over the past six months had resulted in record over-subscription ratios for share issues.
Some institutions and individuals had tried to bid on overdraft to increase their chances of winning, the analysts said.
